title: The Last Ember Anew
premise: Hazel Nystrom has spent his life in the valley where magic cannot follow, hiding from the hedge-witch who raised him and the gift he refuses to name. When a dying stranger presses a map into his hands, Hazel learns the king of the realm has been hollowed out and replaced by an ember-spirit wearing his crown—and that Hazel's own forgotten inheritance is the only flame that can burn it free. Crossing beyond the valley for the first time, Hazel follows the map through lands where his magic awakens painfully into being, pursued by the crown's ash-bound servants. In the throne room, Hazel must choose between remaining invisible and claiming a birthright that will cost him every memory of the valley that made him; he unbinds the king and accepts the price, ending the story as someone new—belonging not to a place, but to himself.
about_author: Noor Delacroix is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing letters no one claimed before turning to fiction. They write about people who inherit things they never asked for, and live at the edge of a forest they refuse to name.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. We meet him tending the hedge-witch's cottage while pretending to be talentless, until a fevered stranger collapses at the treeline and presses a scorched map into his hands with a warning about the crowned thing. The witch recognizes the seal and orders Hazel to burn it. Emotional beat: the first crack in Hazel's safe invisibility—the terror and secret thrill of being seen.

chapters.title: Ash on the Road
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. Fleeing the valley after ash-bound riders come for the map, Hazel crosses the boundary where magic cannot follow—and feels it flood back into him like blood into a numb limb. Guided by the map's shifting ink, he finds allies in a river-town of exiled spellwrights who recognize his surname. Emotional beat: belonging glimpsed for the first time, and the fear it can be taken.

chapters.title: The Hollow Crown
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV, intercut with the ember-spirit's. Infiltrating the capital during a coronation renewal rite, Hazel learns the truth: the spirit is sustained by stolen memories, including fragments of his own mother's flame—he is heir to the last true ember. Captured by the crown's servants, he bargains with the imprisoned, flickering king. Emotional beat: rising dread and resolve as Hazel accepts he was never meant to stay hidden.

chapters.title: What the Fire Keeps
chapters.summary: Hazel's POV. In the throne room, Hazel kindles his inherited ember to unbind the king, watching the spirit feed on his memories of the valley—the witch, the cottage, the boy he was. He lets them go. The king wakes; the spirit gutters out. Epilogue beat: Hazel, memory-light but whole, plants a new hedge by the palace wall. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into chosen belonging.
